[SWS_CM_11413] Deserializing incomplete data on the proxy side belonging to
a field and initValue not defined
Upstream requirements:
RS_CM_00202
⌈
If less data than expected shall be de-serialized on the proxy side and the data to be
de-serialized belong to a
Field
and the
initValue
is not defined the data shall be
discarded. In case of a received REQUEST message (see [PRS_SOMEIP_00055]),
